global_feedback: The library claims 65 final seeds but the provided candidate_library contains far fewer sequences, so plan coverage is incomplete.
Protocol validity is poor overall: many frames mix IEC 60870-5-101 FT1.2 concepts with IEC 60870-5-104 APCI framing, invent undocumented field layouts, or use impossible length/control combinations.
Several expected_behavior strings contradict the supplied sources by mapping seeds to the wrong TypeID/function semantics.
Documentary grounding is weak in execution even when evidence_ids are attached; many concrete hex payloads do not match the cited IEC 60870 framing rules.
Structural diversity exists at the label/plan level, but much of it is cosmetic because multiple seeds are malformed variants of short 0x68 frames rather than source-valid distinct operations.
Stateful depth is only meaningfully attempted in one sequence, and even that sequence reuses malformed frames instead of documented STARTDT/TESTFR plus a valid interrogation ASDU.
Deterministic error list already flags duplicate removals and invalid hex elsewhere; this library still shows additional effective duplicates and malformed frame shapes not caught by that list.

For PK-only quality, prioritize a small set of source-valid seeds over broad but invalid coverage claims. Rebuild around either clean IEC 60870-5-104 APDUs or clean IEC 60870-5-101 FT1.2 frames, not hybrids.

coverage_gaps: Missing clean, source-valid IEC 60870-5-104 U-format seeds for STARTDT act/con, STOPDT act/con, and TESTFR act/con using exact documented control bytes.
Missing at least one clearly valid 104 I-format General Interrogation (C_IC_NA_1 TypeID 100, activation COT, qualifier 20).
Missing valid canonical single command and double command seeds with unambiguous TypeIDs 45 and 46 and properly encoded command qualifiers.
Missing one verified read command C_RD_NA_1 and one clock synchronization C_CS_NA_1 with consistent ASDU layout.
No trustworthy valid measurement/report seeds despite many claimed monitoring operations; need at least one verified M_SP_NA_1 and one M_ST_NA_1 or M_ME_* sample.
No clean separation between IEC 60870-5-101 FT1.2 coverage and IEC 60870-5-104 APCI coverage; choose variant-specific seed subsets or provide both correctly.
Stateful depth should include a valid handshake then one or more valid I-format ASDUs, not malformed control frames.
Coverage for parameter/file-transfer TypeIDs 110-126 is claimed but not credibly realized with source-valid frames.
Many planned operations from the 65-plan list have no corresponding trustworthy final seed, so actual operation coverage is far below advertised.

Need explicit frame-shape diversity with truly distinct valid shapes: pure U-format, I-format with IOA present, sequence-format VSQ examples, timed CP24Time2a/CP56Time2a examples, and if 101 is included, valid FT1.2 fixed/variable-length frames with checksum and 0x16 end delimiter.
